invariants.rationale: The method always operates on properties, which should not be null.
If element is null, the method does not proceed, but properties must still be non-null as per its usage.
Method only processes if element is not null and its name is 'properties', so absence of those short-circuits the loop.
If element is not null, its name is accessed and compared.
If element is not null, its name is checked to match 'properties'.
